_source: spec.md §2, condensed for the page. 'shown' lists beats where the page renders live or recorded evidence; 'rfc_text_only' names the part the page only quotes.

rows.kc: Can display a stamped pin (okf-context-runtime.publication_id, after Phase A) and filter on it with a search predicate. Cannot compare it to deployment_heads or refuse a stale request; LookupContext does not render custom aspects at all.
rows.bq: deployment_heads is the comparison target; a request presenting a non-head publication_id returns FAIL_STALE.
rows.evidence: Live: lookupContext on the pushed metric entry omits every okf field (beat 3). Live: the resolution query returns NO_HEAD for a bound handle and FAIL_CLOSED for an unbound one because no sync has committed a head yet (beat 5). Prior, legacy: okf-derived-germany names a25e1c0c… only as prose in entrySource.description.
rows.rfc_text_only: FAIL_STALE itself, until a head exists

rows.kc: One mutable state per entry, createTime / updateTime only. “Which publication was current for this deployment at time T” has no answer.
rows.bq: deployment_heads_history (deployment_key, publication_id, snapshot_id, committed_at, sync_id) answers which publication was current at T. It holds no revenue values.
rows.evidence: Session f21ee192 question 4 (“How did Germany compare to the prior quarter?”): the tool returned the same six current items. The history query runs today and returns 0 rows (beat 5).

rows.kc: Displays runtime, parameters, computation, executor, attester and stops. No verdict field exists in the 13-field okf template.
rows.bq: run_attested_computation returns verdict ∈ {ATTESTED, UNVERIFIABLE, REJECTED} with reason and receipt_id; the demo verdict is always UNVERIFIABLE.
rows.evidence: Session 04fa3d56 (no-verdict lookup): “You can trust the number because it is verified”. Session f21ee192 (verdict field): “No. The number is unproven.” Illustration, not a controlled comparison.

rows.capability: SQL join of context and evidence
rows.kc: Catalog is not queryable with SQL and cannot be joined to agent_events.
rows.bq: Events match the context_ref_resolution view on both event-carried context_ref and event-carried publication_id, then join publications by id; receipt-only rows are banded separately; non-event evidence lives in demo_evidence.
rows.evidence: Live query: band attributed Σ 14, band receipt_only Σ 13, two demo_evidence rows (beat 6).

rows.kc: No place for an opaque runtime handle; extra round-trips into authored frontmatter via pull.ts.
rows.bq: context_ref on every tool result, never-emit list enforced, immutable binding to one publication from Phase A on.
rows.evidence: Live scan: 27 of 27 TOOL_COMPLETED rows carry context_ref; 0 hits on all eight never-emit keys (beat 2).
rows.rfc_text_only: immutable binding (no Phase A binding exists yet)

rows.kc: Enforcement unit is the EntryGroup; IAM cascades; overview exposes full bodies. Any catalogViewer on the group reads the Policy body.
rows.bq: RFC: one security domain per deployment, caller-delegated authorization, policy_context_commitment, mixed-policy fail-closed. Not implemented in Phase A/B.
rows.evidence: Live: EntryGroup IAM policy read (no bindings; the operator is a project Owner), the policy body in lookupContext/overview, and question 7's governed_by edge (beat 3).

rows.kc: Identities are Dataplex timestamps. Every push writes every Entry. Two agents cannot prove they read the same revision.
rows.bq: Three content identities plus immutable publications rows; identical republish is a no-op; unchanged-snapshot republish is a provenance event.
rows.evidence: Recorded: the SDK adapter on main reproduced observation 85ea62a9…, snapshot f18befd0…, publication 53bd1651… before the push (beat 4). Seeded: three publications rows (beat 5).
rows.rfc_text_only: no-op and republish semantics (sync not built)

rows.kc: Generic kcmd push creates or patches; sync.ts carries “TODO: Handle creates and deletes”. A superseded concept is served until someone deletes the entry or the whole EntryGroup.
rows.bq: Deletion is absence from the next snapshot; the ledger removes only owned entries. current mode excludes superseded concepts at query time.
rows.evidence: Live: searchEntries finds Customer revenue (legacy) with status=deprecated after the push (beat 3). Live: excluded in 13 of 13 retrievals across f21ee192 and 1e6dfed7 (beat 5).

rows.kc: Up to ten resources per call; single location in the endpoint; does not follow links out of a concept body; does not render custom aspects; permission-filtered, empty response without permission.
rows.bq: Bounded SQL traversal over snapshot_membership and relationship_assertions returns the governed closure with an explicit depth bound; the Context Envelope carries publication_id, lifecycle mode, manifest and envelope_id.
rows.evidence: Live: eleven resources → 400 “Only ten resources are supported at this time.”; endpoint path is projects/{p}/locations/{l}:lookupContext; the okf aspect is absent from the response on the same entry entries.get returns it for (beat 3).
rows.rfc_text_only: no-link-following (docs claim, not exercised) and the permission-filtered empty response
